notes:
• You can now book time with a start and end time instead of hours. Turn on Book with start and end times in Settings. It's off unless you turn it on.
• With it on, Book time asks when you started and finished, and for any break. For example, 9:00 to 12:30 less a 30 minute break books 3 hours, and ConnectWise shows those times with the break taken off.
• When you stop the timer, it fills in the start and end times for you.
